selfReview.method: Read source-bound Japanese and Khmer paragraphs, explanatory sections and complete dialogues in sequence; reviewed stems/options and every source-specific rationale directly against Japanese. semanticChecks: Eating retains nutrition, pleasure, social connection and life-rhythm functions. Food recognition through senses does not prove hand movement, chewing, swallowing or nutritional sufficiency.

Digestive tract sequence, digestion versus absorption, small-intestine nutrient absorption, large-intestine water absorption, liver/gallbladder/pancreas roles remain distinct. Eye/ear structures and endocrine/immune/circulatory knowledge do not authorize individual diagnosis or treatment.

Chewing, swallowing, aspiration below vocal cords, swallowing disorder and airway obstruction remain separate; no cough does not prove no aspiration. Emergency breathing signs retain immediate help under facility procedures; no self-directed water administration or untrained rescue technique.

Food size alone is not safety. Chopped, soft, paste and thickened foods retain different properties, cohesion and water separation; actual changes require individual assessment/plan, product instructions, facility procedure and training.

Illegible food-form labels do not negate the readable name but leave food form unknown. Current individual content, allergies/restrictions and tray/label must be checked before provision. Yesterday is not proof; confirmation, replacement and receipt remain future actions where source says so.

Dish-position consent is not permission to move the hand or feed everything. Existing ability and person choice remain; assistive utensils supplement specific difficulty and do not resolve swallowing disorders automatically.

Seating/body/sole support, worker height, neck position and individual posture assessment are retained. Bed feeding and unaffected-side examples remain conditional on assessment, individual plan and practical training; no universal angle or posture added.

Clock-position orientation remains from the person: far12, near6, rice3/right, tofu12/far. Alternative scene vegetables9/left and rice12 preserved. Method is not universal; temperature and food details still need words. Waiting is not guaranteed cooling and temperature is rechecked; adding water changes properties.

Do not talk to the person during chewing; choose a time when the person can speak. Check previous mouthful and oral residue before next, preserve pace/amount, and report cough/voice/breathing/fatigue/discomfort observations without diagnosis.

Rest versus ending remain distinct. Later restart choice/time are unknown; dishes remain at stated request and staff report to responsible person. Post-meal mouth care/posture and approximate30min sitting are plan-bound, not universal prescriptions.

12:35Morikawa ate about half rice and one-quarter side dishes, not amounts remaining. Reason and drink quantity unknown; never fill unknown with zero. Observation and quoted statement remain separate and explicit nurse recipient preserved.

Before dinner Onodera common menu rice versus individual porridge remains unresolved. Kawase checks latest plan; care worker informs kitchen, then compares confirmed content/label/tray before serving. Substitute item does not establish milk allergy.
